goal: Assess whether any genuinely new Oct23 4h Bybit BTCUSDT Spot natural MR40 entry gets adverse before a profit-trigger trailing stop would arm, without choosing a threshold by inspecting future returns.

fixed_measurement.position_model: LONG only; risk telemetry based on next 4h OPEN reference after signal at previous confirmed close; no claim to actual fill
fixed_measurement.floating_loss_at_low: 500-example cash + BTC position marked at each held 4h candle LOW after illustrative buy/sell taker fee; no fill at candle LOW is assumed
fixed_measurement.net_realized_PnL: For only a fully closed position, next 4h OPEN-based natural exit after previous natural exit close; illustrative 0.1pct fee per side; never treat an unclosed day-end position as realized
fixed_measurement.unclosed_handling: No forced day-end liquidation. Record incomplete or pending next open separately. Censor time-based adverse observation; no imaginary exit price.
fixed_measurement.baseline_comparison: Same natural MR40 signals and timing; no risk control activated and no new stop hypothetical fills; a future separate immutable risk-budget policy may be compared only after explicit precommit and source proof.
fixed_measurement.protects_against: False positive claims: no entry before next candle, no low of post-exit candle, no profit arm triggered by high without completed CLOSE, no same-candle stop fill, no when-incomplete PNL
